name: Substrate multi-occurrence role-filler binding (permutation P^k)
description: Substrate-only multi-occurrence role-filler binding via permutation-indexed P^k binding. End-task multi-occurrence subset 0.388 (+0.34 over FHRR baseline 0.047); isolation recovery 1.0. Off-attractor mechanism (not discriminative_perceptron / fhrr_unbind / cleanup).

solution_history.replacement_reason: Plain FHRR bind cannot disambiguate non-unique (repeated) role-fillers; multi-occurrence end-task collapses to 0.047 (near-chance) because identical fillers superpose indistinguishably

Permutation-indexed P^k binding (cyclic shift roll by k*7 per occurrence) makes repeated fillers distinguishable by position; isolation recovery 1.0 and end-task multi-occurrence subset 0.388 (+0.34 over FHRR)
